bio.summary: Kappa Kyle, the Cucumber-Debt Collector is a fictional kappa (Japanese water imp, folklore) standup performer. 400-year-old Japanese river imp who moved to the city and now runs a protection racket payable exclusively in cucumbers. Bows at everyone, including automatic doors. The act circles dave's nine and the pickle insult. Onstage the register is deadpan.
